classification.difficultyReason: Infer likely clustering from each context before matching a curve, linking difficult or easy examinations to tail direction and two sporting groups to two clusters.

content.prompt: Match each of the following descriptions to one of the curves, A to D below.

spec.description: Two approximately equal-height peaks separated by a trough, with both outer tails approaching the horizontal axis.
spec.mathematics: Schematic unscaled distribution curve; no equation, numerical scale or horizontal-axis title is supplied in the PDF.
spec.answerVisibility: Curve label A and frequency-axis label f are givens. No matching response is printed.

spec.description: One approximately symmetric bell-shaped peak with both tails approaching the horizontal axis.
spec.mathematics: Schematic unscaled distribution, without an asserted probability model or equation.
spec.answerVisibility: Curve label B and frequency-axis label f are givens. No matching response is printed.

spec.description: A steep rise to a left-hand peak followed by a long right-hand tail.
spec.mathematics: Schematic positively skewed distribution. No numerical scale, equation or horizontal-axis title is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Curve label C and frequency-axis label f are givens. No matching response is printed.

spec.description: A long left-hand tail leading to a right-hand peak, followed by a steep fall.
spec.mathematics: Schematic negatively skewed distribution. No numerical scale, equation or horizontal-axis title is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Curve label D and frequency-axis label f are givens. No matching response is printed.

children.label: a
children.prompt: the heights of 1000 randomly selected adult women

answer.worked: Assuming the heights form one approximately symmetric cluster, curve B fits.

children.label: b
children.prompt: the results in a difficult examination

answer.worked: Assuming most results are low and relatively few are high, the distribution has a longer right tail. This matches curve C.

children.label: c
children.prompt: the weights of jockeys and wrestlers

answer.worked: The intended model has two weight clusters, one for each sporting group. The two peaks match curve A.

children.label: d
children.prompt: the results in an easy examination

answer.worked: Assuming most results are high and relatively few are low, the distribution has a longer left tail. This matches curve D.
